verdict.rationale: 1Password documents storing and "quickly accessing" one-time passwords, including lookup from an Apple Watch. The browser guide mentions "find what you need", which loosely implies search, and the CLI's `--vault` option shows items can be grouped into vaults. None of this evidence describes organizing dozens of TOTP tokens specifically, so the story is only partly supported. Missing for 10: explicit search for OTP items, folder/tag grouping of tokens in the main apps, service icons, evidence of two-tap access to codes, and independent hands-on corroboration.
